Title: VPN connection fails after Windows update
Description: Several employees cannot connect to the corporate VPN after a Windows update; the client reports authentication timeouts.
Resolution: Updated the VPN client profile, repaired the authentication configuration and verified connectivity on affected devices.

Title: Internal .NET API returns HTTP 500
Description: The order management ASP.NET Core API intermittently returns HTTP 500; logs show SQL connection pool exhaustion.
Resolution: Fixed undisposed database connections, adjusted connection pooling and added integration tests for concurrent requests.

Title: Docker container cannot connect to PostgreSQL
Description: A Dockerized backend service fails to reach PostgreSQL because the database hostname is incorrect.
Resolution: Changed the database host to the Docker Compose service name and verified connectivity across containers.

Title: React dashboard shows a blank screen
Description: After a frontend deployment, the React dashboard renders a blank page and the console reports a failed module import.

Title: GitHub Actions pipeline fails during .NET build
Description: The CI workflow fails because dotnet build runs from the repository root instead of the backend project directory.
Resolution: Set the correct working directory in GitHub Actions and added restore, build and test steps.

Title: JWT authentication tokens expire unexpectedly
Description: Users are signed out too quickly because ASP.NET Core middleware rejects valid refresh tokens.
Resolution: Corrected refresh-token validation and middleware ordering; added tests for token renewal and expiration.

Title: PostgreSQL reports slow queries during peak hours
Description: Reporting queries take over 20 seconds and execution plans show sequential scans on large order tables.

Title: AWS application cannot reach PostgreSQL
Description: A service running in AWS cannot connect to the database after a security group change.

Title: React form submits incomplete JSON payload
Description: A React and TypeScript ticket form intermittently omits the description property from API requests.
Resolution: Fixed stale React state handling, added client-side validation and covered the request payload with component tests.

Title: Docker Compose frontend cannot reach backend API
Description: The frontend container uses the wrong backend hostname in its proxy configuration.

Title: AWS deployment fails to read environment secrets
Description: A Python service deployed on AWS cannot read required environment secrets because its IAM role lacks permissions.
Resolution: Granted least-privilege IAM access to the required secrets and validated startup in the deployment environment.

Title: LiteLLM proxy returns provider configuration error
Description: Requests through LiteLLM fail because the configured model alias does not match the provider route.
Resolution: Corrected the LiteLLM model alias and provider settings; verified successful completion requests.

Title: Kubernetes deployment enters CrashLoopBackOff
Description: A Kubernetes deployment repeatedly restarts after a configuration update; the readiness probe fails.
Resolution: Fixed the container startup configuration and readiness probe path, then verified stable rollout.

Title: Encrypted files cannot be decrypted after key rotation
Description: A Python worker cannot decrypt archived files because the key identifier is not preserved in the encrypted payload metadata.
Resolution: Stored key identifiers with encrypted payload metadata and added backward-compatible decryption tests.

Title: React table loses filters after navigation
Description: The React dashboard loses selected filters when users open a ticket and return to the list.
Resolution: Persisted filter state in URL search parameters and added navigation regression tests.

Title: Python data processing job crashes on malformed input
Description: A scheduled Python ETL task fails when input rows contain missing timestamps or invalid values.
Resolution: Added input schema validation, quarantined invalid rows and recorded structured error logs.

Title: New .NET middleware causes CORS failures
Description: A recently introduced ASP.NET Core middleware component blocks browser requests to the API due to incorrect ordering.

Title: GitHub Actions deployment workflow fails to publish image
Description: The CI/CD workflow builds successfully but fails when pushing a Docker image to the container registry.

Title: LiteLLM requests fail intermittently under load
Description: The Python AI gateway returns intermittent upstream errors when many LiteLLM requests are sent concurrently.

Title: Kubernetes service cannot access encrypted secrets
Description: A Kubernetes workload fails to read encrypted application secrets after a namespace configuration change.
